name: 9Router
description: 9Router is a local AI gateway for coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and Copilot. It exposes one OpenAI-compatible endpoint and routes requests across 40+ AI providers with multi-tier fallback, format translation, token-saving filters and per-key usage tracking, managed from a web dashboard.

notes.text: Sign in at http://<IP>:20128/dashboard with INITIAL_PASSWORD from /opt/9router_data/.env.
Update with the update command in the container, not the dashboard's Update button: that one restarts 9Router outside its service.
